elevate.move: Make the tape list the typographic system: every section heading becomes a dated entry (small-caps month in the margin, Literata italic entry at display size, one Caveat tick drawing in), retiring the separate eyebrows so a text-only screenshot reads as the freezer-lid inventory.

Set the h1 on a large tape strip as the first line of the lid list, with trade and city in it, and butt the marquee directly beneath as the next lines of the same list, so the hero is one lid object instead of a headline floating above a strip.
